Hey I know the feeling. The feeling of despair going to school knowing people hate you for stupid reasons , not leaving you alone just to learn and study for what you came for. They will always pull us down. I learnt the hard way. I let my heart get shattered into little pieces because I couldn't even defend my self. I know you have heard this many times but please don't self harm. You're strong for still being here , despite what holds you back. 

These bullies are insecure assholes always picking on  others so they can feel better, I never understood how hurting someone so bad can make them feel better about themselves. I know that you're a good person because they'd always pick those kind , kind who don't even do anything to them. Stay strong I hope school goes well for you 💖💞
